Shelves of colorful pharmaceutical products are visible in the background, and there is a small poster on the door with Japanese text and graphics. (2) The camera shifts to a handheld perspective, panning across multiple store shelves densely packed with various health and beauty products. Specific items like foot deodorant sprays and laundry detergents in bottles and pouches are highlighted in a medium close-up. The packaging features a mix of pink, blue, and orange colors with Japanese labels. (3) A right hand with manicured nails enters the frame, holding a small retail package of a "Shimitori" stain remover pen. The camera zooms in for a close-up of the red and white packaging, emphasizing the brand name and product illustrations. The setting is still the brightly lit store aisle. The person places a folded white napkin behind the stain and uses the stain remover pen to rub the spot in a circular motion. The lighting is soft and warm. (5) The final phase takes place outdoors in a sunny environment. A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a brown ribbed turtleneck, smiles brightly at the camera while holding the product. The background features a traditional Japanese temple structure and vibrant green trees, illuminated by clear natural daylight.
